gloss: soreness after a massage; post-massage pain

definitions.gloss: soreness after a massage; post-massage pain
definitions.explanation: The muscle pain or stiffness that can occur after receiving a massage, especially if the massage was too deep or intense. A common experience discussed in everyday Japanese life.

examples.japanese: ⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{揉|も}み{返|かえ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きつい→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧。
⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{揉|も}み→揉む：00289_momu⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{揉|も}み{返|かえ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: If you massage too hard, you'll get soreness afterward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{整体|せいたい}→整体：27407_seitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{揉|も}み{返|かえ}しで、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦だるい→だるい：05307_darui⟧。
examples.english: Because of the post-massage soreness from yesterday's chiropractic session, my body feels sluggish today.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{揉|も}む→揉む：00289_momu⟧ (to massage, to knead) + ⟦{返|かえ}し→返し：24802_kaeshi⟧ (return, rebound). Literally the 'comeback' from being massaged.

USAGE:
Very common in everyday conversation when discussing massage experiences. Often used with ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ ({揉|も}み{返|かえ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧) to express the onset of post-massage soreness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {揉|も}み{返|かえ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (to get post-massage soreness)
- {揉|も}み{返|かえ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧ (the soreness is bad)
- {揉|も}み{返|かえ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ (soreness lingers)
